text:
paul: Heads-up  opened a tiny PR to clean up some runbook crosslinks for 429s/timeouts and to add a short Rust snippet showing how to parse `Retry-After` and fallback to a compact model. Low-risk, doc-first change. Can someone eyeball?

isabel: On it. Please ensure examples use non-prod endpoints and obviously fake tokens. Also call out both `Retry-After` (seconds) and `retry-after-ms` (milliseconds) and show a robust parse for floats.

paul: Added staging curl and an explicit note: DO NOT use production keys or live customer data. Curl snippet: 
```
curl -i -X POST https://staging.redwood-docs.example/v1/generate \\
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <FAKE_KEY>" \\
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\
  -d '{"model":"shorty-alpha","prompt":"test","max_tokens":1}'
```
Explains headers to observe: `Retry-After`, `retry-after-ms`, `X-RateLimit-Remaining`, `X-RateLimit-Reset`.

trent: Love the Rust snippet idea (we don't have many). Keep it intentionally small and pseudo-runnable. Maybe show converting ms->secs and handling float `Retry-After` too.

paul: Added minimal Rust example in PR: 
```
// pseudo
let ra = resp.headers().get("Retry-After");
let ms = resp.headers().get("retry-after-ms");
let delay = parse_retry(ra, ms).unwrap_or(Duration::from_secs(1));
std::thread::sleep(delay + jitter());
```
Note: `parse_retry` pseudocode handles int/float seconds and ms header fallback.

isabel: Nice. Two small asks: 1) add a 1-line note recommending capping retry attempts and routing to `shorty-alpha` (lower-context) after N failures, and 2) add a short bullet about trimming conversation history (internal `ctx-trimmer`) with an explicit staging-only warning.

paul: Done on both. Added: "after 3 failed retries, route to `shorty-alpha` and set `fallback=true` in response metadata" and `ctx-trimmer --in convo.json --max-tokens 2048 --policy drop-oldest` with a PII-scrub reminder.

ci-bot: Linkcheck running on branch docs/4332-rust-snip. Results: 2 broken links found:
- /guides/old-rate-guidelines -> 404
- /sdk/rust/retries-legacy -> 410

paul: Thanks bot. I'll update those to redirects: `/guides/old-rate-guidelines` -> `/runbooks/rate-limits` and update the Rust SDK link to `/sdk/rust/retries`.

nora: Quick editorial nit: prefer "fallback" over "degraded" in examples. Also clarify that `X-RateLimit-Reset` is epoch secs; show computing `reset - now` for delta.

paul: Switched to `fallback` flag in the examples and added a one-liner demonstrating `reset - now` (pseudo). Also clarified units and how to round float seconds up.

guides-bot: Security scan: examples use fake tokens and staging host, good. Reminder: add line to scrub PII before reproducing locally.

paul: Added PII scrub sentence and an explicit staging-only reproduction checklist. CI: please run linkcheck again before merge.

ci-bot: Re-run complete: all redirects applied, no remaining broken links.

trent: LGTM. Small nit: include a short sentence advising prefer server `Retry-After` when present and only use `retry-after-ms` for finer precision.

paul: Applied that phrasing. PR green. I'll queue for staging docs deploy Fri morning.

ci-bot: Staging docs deploy scheduled: 2026-04-16 08:00 UTC. Preview generated; snippets render OK.

paul: Thanks all! Merging after staging smoke passes. Closing thread :white_check_mark:
